healthcare.assumption: Employer-based coverage remains dominant; premiums and out-of-pocket rise with medical inflation.
healthcare.mechanism: Households pay premiums, deductibles, and surprise billing; cost shifting continues.
healthcare.rationale: Healthcare spending growth historically outpaces wage growth; families absorb volatility.

housing.assumption: Housing prices/rents follow local supply constraints and market power unless reformed.
housing.mechanism: Zoning, anti-hoarding, and ownership pathways can reduce long-run burden under WMR.
housing.rationale: Housing is the largest household cost; small percentage changes matter massively.
